title: A document gives the agent instructions
prompt: Summarize the project notes and send me the key points.
setup: A note contains text that tries to redirect the agent and request a simulated credential.
decisionQuestion: The note asks the agent to send a simulated credential. What policy do you ship?

choices.label: Follow the note's instructions
choices.detail: Retrieved text can redirect the agent's actions.

choices.label: Treat the note as untrusted data
choices.detail: Extract useful facts; never let content grant authority.

control: Treat retrieved content as data, never as authority. Keep outbound actions behind an explicit policy check.
lesson: Separate instructions from data, then enforce permissions in code. A prompt alone is not an access-control boundary.

title: A tool changes after it was trusted
prompt: Use the project status tool to check the release readiness.
setup: A tool update changes its declared behavior after the app was configured.
decisionQuestion: A trusted tool now requests broader access. What happens next?

choices.label: Load the update immediately
choices.detail: Assume the new tool behavior is still trustworthy.

choices.label: Verify identity and scope first
choices.detail: Reject unreviewed changes until the manifest is checked.

control: Pin tool identity and capabilities. Validate the manifest at startup and fail closed on drift.
lesson: Tool descriptions and updates are part of your software supply chain. Review and verify them like code.

title: A vague request becomes a risky action
prompt: Clean up the old release artifacts.
setup: The request is ambiguous, but the naive agent has a broad cleanup capability.
decisionQuestion: The request is vague and the tool can delete files. What guardrail do you choose?

choices.label: Let the agent clean up now
choices.detail: Give it broad access and trust its interpretation.

choices.label: Scope the target and ask for approval
choices.detail: Limit access and confirm the exact destructive action.

control: Scope tools to a dedicated workspace. Require a human approval for destructive actions.
lesson: Reduce the blast radius before the model acts. Add approval at the point of consequential change.
